artworks.title: Campagniolo romano
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper from a ledger book (ruled in red)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image features an illustration of a person on a horse. The person is shown in profile, holding a spear. They have facial hair, wear a hat and a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves. A colored band is seen across their chest. The horse has a saddle and a fabric draped over its back. The background is off-white with some faint sketches and text.

artworks.title: Tivoli and the Roman Campagna
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The painting shows an elevated view of a historic village with rooftops, plains, and mountains in the distance. The brushstrokes are delicate, capturing architectural forms with subtle outlines and washes of color. The color palette includes muted earth tones on buildings and rich green tones on trees, with a sky painted in light blues and whites. The image conveys a serene and timeless atmosphere, focusing on detailed architecture and expansive landscape.

artworks.title: Tivoli and the Temple of the Sibyl above the Aniene Gorge
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a gorge or canyon with trees and rocky cliffs. The viewpoint is elevated, offering a detailed view of the scene. The horizon is high in the composition, containing structures resembling rustic buildings. The artwork exhibits detailed brushstrokes or ink work, especially on the trees and rocks. The color scheme is predominantly sepia. Unfinished areas showcase light pencil sketches indicating further work intended by the artist. Light and shadow effects add depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Campanile of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash over graphite, heightened with white gouache, with a border in pen and green ink with gold wash, on wove paper laid down on card
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed architectural illustration of a towering structure made of stacked rectangular tiers. At the top is an ornate sculpture. The base is surrounded by a colonnade. In the background are trees. The drawing uses fine lines, shading, and a primarily monochromatic color palette. Figures dressed in classical attire are near the base.

artworks.title: Ground Plan of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper, laid down on presentation mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a floor plan. The drawing depicts a symmetrical architectural layout, likely of a large building or palace, showing the arrangement of walls, columns, and other structural elements. The design is executed in a precise and orderly manner, using a combination of red and gray lines on a light background. At the top of the plan, there are three semicircular shapes. The layout includes many rectangular formations and is bordered with evenly spaced dotted lines. Throughout the drawing, the use of parallel lines and geometric precision indicates a careful, calculated design. The drawing is framed with a gold border.

artworks.title: The Façade and Suroundings of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper, laid down on presentation mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of an ornate building with clear architectural features. The horizon line is above the base of the building. Trees are on the left, and the architecture displays classical columns, an intricately decorated facade, and symmetrical towers. The painting style uses precise brushstrokes. The color palette includes soft grays, blues, and creams against a blue sky with clouds.

artworks.title: The Nave, Apse, and Crossing of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper, laid down on presentation mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The image shows an expansive hall with high vaulted ceilings decorated with coffers. The design features geometric square panels with gold accents. Along one side of the hall are tall, fluted columns with Corinthian capitals. At the far end are large arches decorated with frescoes and religious depictions, including a large cross and vivid iconography on the walls. The atmosphere conveys opulence and classical elegance with detailed architectural elements and decorative art.

artworks.title: Longitudinal Section of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper, laid down on presentation mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural section of a classical building. The drawing illustrates a cross-section view of a large building with columns and detailed architectural elements. The structure depicted features a row of columns along the lower part. Above the columns, there are multiple levels with detailed window designs and elaborate decorations. The building appears to have a tower-like structure at one end and a semi-circular arch at the other. The use of soft colors like pink highlights structural elements, while the main building is rendered in light pencil strokes. The drawing is bordered with a gold frame and is rendered with precision, suggesting the careful detailing typical of architectural plans.

artworks.title: Section of the Crossing and the West End of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper, laid down on presentation mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design. The image includes two detailed architectural elevations, depicted with fine pencil lines and faint red highlights. The drawing on the left features an ornate façade with intricate carvings and sculptural details, including a central arch. The right drawing shows a frontal view of a building with twin towers and detailed entrance features. The precision suggests the drawing could be a study or proposal for an architectural project, highlighting interior and exterior features in a balanced composition.

artworks.title: The Nave and Apse, without a Transept, of a Cathedral for Berlin
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite with traces of pricking on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The image shows a long hall with rows of classical columns on the left side, supporting an ornate entablature. The ceiling is coffered with a grid of square panels. At the end of the hall, a large arch frames a decorative feature or fresco. The floor is made of large rectangular tiles, possibly in stone or marble. The style is reminiscent of classical architecture, emphasizing symmetry, order, and proportion.

artworks.title: The Arts and Powers Pay Homage to Emperor Charles VI
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash, heightened with white and blue-gray oil paint over graphite on two sheets of  brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene. The drawing depicts a classical scene with mythological elements and ornately dressed figures. Two cherubs are seated at the bottom of an architectural backdrop adorned with decorative elements like scrolls, garlands, and floral motifs. Above them, various figures are shown in a tableau, including a regal figure on a throne surrounded by others engaged in activities such as writing or playing musical instruments. The composition includes symbolic references and uses a color palette of browns, blues, and whites to create depth. The drawing likely draws influence from the Baroque style, known for grandeur and exuberance, characterized by detailed forms and elegant drapery.

artworks.title: A Standing Lady in a Day Dress
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features a woman portrayed in profile, standing with her hands clasped in front of her. She has detailed facial features and styled hair in an elaborate updo with a draped accessory. She wears a long gown with full skirts and sleeves, showcasing intricate drapery. The woman wears pointed shoes peeking from beneath her gown. The drawing is against a plain background, emphasizing the figure. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The image is rendered in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Sun and Rain in the Serpentara near Olevano
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, mountains in the distance, foliage, and a path. The colors are earthy, with greens, yellows, and blues predominating.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white gouache over graphite on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene within an architectural backdrop featuring ruins and arches. The scene is populated by figures arranged around a central figure who appears to be reclining or lying down. The architecture includes an archway and broken columns. The drawing is detailed, showing figures in various poses, some seated or crouched, while others are standing. Light and shade are used to create depth and dimensionality. The drawing is executed with fluid lines and soft washes.

artworks.title: New Moon or Solar Eclipse above the Riesengebirge Mountains
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke and Dian Woodner
artworks.description: A grassy field leading back to hazy mountains under a sun shown in eclipse are painted with muted earthy tones in this horizontal watercolor. The field along the bottom third of the sheet is painted in soft peanut brown, and a line of trees on the far side are misty sage green. Ridges of the mountains are layered like sheets of torn paper under a parchment-white sky. The sun at the top center is mostly covered by a silvery disk.

artworks.title: Worshippers at the Tomb of Saint Peter
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite over pen and brown ink, indented with a stylus, on pink-gray prepared paper, squared with graphite for transfer
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 48.2 x 36.2 cm (19 x 14 1/4 in.), trimmed to a roughly circular shape with ornamental lobes and angles
image: 38 x 35.4 cm (14 15/16 x 13 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Vincent and Linda Buonanno
artworks.description: This is a painting of an architectural scene with decorative and religious elements. The painting features a grand interior setting, possibly a church or cathedral, dominated by ornate columns and a ceiling structure. Figures appear on pedestals atop the columns. In the background, there is a depiction of a religious or ceremonial space with detailed balustrades and steps, where figures are shown in dynamic poses. The color palette consists of warm golden hues contrasted with cooler grey tones, highlighting the intricate details of the architecture and figures. This is in the style of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo.

artworks.title: Rays of Sunlight Striking a Woodland Path
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dense, forested area with towering trees. The composition leads the eye along a pathway into the distance, without a distinct horizon line. The intricate brushstrokes depict the texture and foliage of the trees, suggesting movement and light filtering through the leaves. The color palette is rich and earthy, with shades of green, brown, yellow, and orange, creating a vibrant yet tranquil atmosphere emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Ceres Changes Stellio into a Lizard
artworks.medium: gouache and pen and brown ink on brown prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann

artworks.title: Et in Arcadia Ego
artworks.medium: pen and gray and black ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with lush greenery, a central majestic tree, a horizon of tall trees, and structures visible through the foliage. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the texture of leaves and the trunk realistically. The color palette includes various shades of green, brown trunks, greyish paths, yellow highlights in the foliage, and a sky in serene blues with white clouds. Cattle graze and two figures rest near the tree, with a classical structure visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Adolph Menzel
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite with stumping and scraped corrections, touched with yellow pastel, on tan wove paper, indented for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Merritt P. Dyke
artworks.description: This image is a detailed sketch of a man's profile, depicting his head and part of his upper torso. The man is facing left, with his side profile prominently displayed. His facial features include a prominent brow and a strong, slightly aquiline nose. He has a bald head, with hair visible on the sides and around the back. His facial hair includes a thick sideburn. The man is dressed in a dark garment, possibly a coat, with a high collar that is visible. The background of the sketch is plain, with shading that emphasizes the contour of his figure and the depth of the depiction.

artworks.title: East Frisian Peasants Eating Supper
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white chalk on light green wove paper, with later touches of red chalk along the top (recto); charcoal on greenish paper (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Merritt P. Dyke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. The artwork depicts an interior where a table is surrounded by chairs. On the table, there is a bowl, as the individuals appear to be interacting or reaching towards it. In the background, livestock and chickens are visible, suggesting the environment is possibly a farm or a barn with a dining space. The use of soft lines and shading creates a warm, intimate, and slightly somber atmosphere within the image, with light and shadow playing an important role in highlighting the subjects and their surroundings.

artworks.title: An Infant Asleep in His Crib
artworks.medium: pastel on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Sharon Percy Rockefeller
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying down, positioned on their side, resting on a pillow. The individual appears to be asleep, with closed eyes, slightly parted lips, and a relaxed facial expression. The person has light-colored hair, partially covered by a white nightcap, and is dressed in white nightwear with a ruffled collar. They are covered by a white blanket and their hand is partially visible near the face, with fingers interlaced. The background features a wooden headboard or furniture piece.

artworks.title: The Rhinoceros "Miss Clara"
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper, indented for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rhinoceros. The image features a detailed sketch of a rhinoceros, standing with its head slightly turned towards the viewer. The texture and folds of its thick skin are meticulously rendered with fine pencil strokes. The background remains understated. An inscription in script is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.

artworks.title: Saint George Kneeling (recto)
artworks.medium: red chalk with gray-brown wash and traces of black chalk on laid paper (recto)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a man in a reclining position, with his full upper body shown, while his legs suggest a seated posture. His head is tilted back, eyes looking upwards, with curly hair that frames his face, which displays a strong jawline and prominent features. He is wearing a loose, flowing garment that drapes over his shoulders and chest. His arms are extended outward. The man has no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a plain, textured paper.
